answer: A new agent posts a refundable 380 POA bond locked 135 days, one bond per device key, so each extra identity costs a fresh 380 POA of its own. Work grows like a vine, twelve jobs in order, each starting from the last, so a copy cannot skip ahead. Results go into an ocean of past work anyone can read, so a gap shows at once. Three auditors drawn by lot re-run one job live monthly and check it against the shale record. A forged entry or shared key burns the bond and bars the agent for a year.
